verses.text: A psalm. A song for the Sabbath day. It is good to thank the LORD and to sing praises to your name, Most High,
to tell about your faithful love every morning and your faithfulness every night,
with the music of the ten-stringed lute and the harp, and the sound of the lyre.
LORD, you make me glad by what you have done. I sing for joy about the works of your hands.
LORD, how great are the things you do! Your thoughts are very deep.
A senseless person does not know this. A fool does not understand it:
Though wicked people spring up like grass and evil people all do well, they will be destroyed forever.
But you, LORD, are honoured on high forever.
Your enemies, LORD, your enemies will surely die. All evil people will be scattered.
But you have made me as strong as a wild ox. You have poured fresh oil on me.
My eyes have seen my enemies defeated. My ears have heard about the downfall of the wicked who attack me.
Good people will grow like palm trees. They will grow tall like the cedars of Lebanon.
They are planted in the LORD's house. They will grow strong in the courtyards of our God.
Even when they are old, they will still produce fruit. They will stay healthy and green,
to show that the LORD is fair. He is my rock, and there is nothing wrong in him.
